name: Deal Stage Ladder
note: Seven labels only. The filter buttons and the card labels both use these exact names, in this order. Use Acquisition or Regulatory approval when that is what the deal is; otherwise the stage of the partnership (funding rounds count as Signed). 'map' re-clusters older words; the sync and the feed apply it and report anything unmapped.

blurbs.Letter of Intent: Announced intent to explore, nothing binding
blurbs.MoU: Memorandum of understanding: agreed in principle, not yet a contract
blurbs.Signed: Contract, agreement or selection in place, not yet in use
blurbs.Launched: Running: pilot, preview, general availability or in production
blurbs.Expanded: Existing live deal widened in scope or scale
blurbs.Acquisition: One party buys another, or a stake in a business
